seo.title: About TablePro
seo.description: Who makes TablePro, how it is funded, where its source code lives and how to reach the team.

header.title: A database client, built in the open.
header.lead: The TablePro team makes TablePro for Mac, Linux, iPhone and iPad. Licenses and sponsors pay for it.

items.name: Native
items.text: One app per platform, each in its own toolkit: Swift with AppKit and SwiftUI on Apple devices, Rust with GTK 4 on Linux.

items.name: Open
items.text: All of the code is on GitHub under the AGPLv3, the paid features included.

items.name: Private
items.text: Passwords stay in your system’s keychain: the Keychain on Apple devices, a Secret Service keyring on Linux.

items.name: Independent
items.text: Licenses and sponsors pay for TablePro. It has no investors and sells no data.
